about_the_game:
WHERE HEAVEN FELL

A challenging 2D platformer about ascending a city forgotten by God and mankind.

Where Heaven Fell is a challenging 2D platformer about climbing to the peak of a city forgotten by God and mankind. Amid forgotten structures, tunnels, and overgrown ruins, the sky glows an eerie white. As one of the few survivors, you embark on a journey to find God and leave this forsaken world behind.

✧ GAME FEATURES ✧

• Distinct movement mechanics.
Slide, dash, and climb through the ruins of the last city standing.

• Unique level design and mechanics.
Ranging from dash refills to ziplines, the game has a wide range of level mechanics that each differ from each other fundamentally.

• 9 chapters of gameplay and over 100 rooms of challenging platforming.

• Characters that each have their own story to tell

about the crumbling world around them.

• Mysteries and in-depth lore

about what truly happened to the city which you attempt ascending from.

• An immersive soundtrack of 20 melodies,

composed by various artists.

• 2–5 hours of difficult gameplay,

including challenges and bonus rooms.

• Two different endings.

• ..And a fallen angel who’s will to God lasts unwavering for generations on end.

✧ YOUR ASCENT AWAITS ✧

Whether you’re searching for a challenge or an atmospheric ascent to prove your faith worthy, Where Heaven Fell is the precision platformer that you’re looking for.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Game will run smoothly in most modern systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics (e.g., GTX 750 / AMD Radeon 7 260 or better)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any, Headphones Recommended
  • Additional Notes: Use a dedicated graphics card for the best performance.

short_description: An unnamed climber, you search for God in your ascent to the pinnacle of the city in which the remainder of the world resides in. A lone traveler accompanies you in your climb. Dash, jump, and climb your way to ascension in this challenging 2D platformer!
supported_languages:
English*, Korean*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
